$comment: NoöPunk regional technology matrix (issue #58). Canonical machine-readable artefact: do not hand-write a second copy in a runtime. This file replaces a single global 'technology level' with per-region profiles over named dimensions, because the author's design decision is that technology is ideological and uneven, not a tech tree.
$time_comment: AGENTS.md §6: canonical future dates are written as 20XX unless the author says otherwise. No exact year is assigned here, and none is implied by the technology matrix.
design_rule: Technology is political and cultural worldbuilding, not equipment progression. Every technological regime gains some capabilities and creates different vulnerabilities, so no region is rankable as simply 'more advanced' than another. There is deliberately no global technology level and no scalar tech score in this file.
$design_rule_note: The anti-ranking rule is the point of the artefact. A consumer that reduces a profile to 'how advanced is this region' has defeated the design, which is why tests/test_issue58_tech_matrix.py asserts every region carries at least one vulnerability and that no scalar aggregate exists.

epistemic_status.$comment: Every regional sketch below is a NoöPunk extrapolation over real present-day actors. Per the issue's own warning, references to current countries, companies and organisations are speculative setting elements, not claims about the real world.
epistemic_status.vocabulary_source: docs/WRITING_STYLE_AND_MODELING.md §4 — established / contested / speculative / fringe / noopunk_extrapolation / in_world_unknown

dimensions.name: AI autonomy
dimensions.notes: How far autonomous machine intelligence is permitted to act without a human decision in the loop.

dimensions.name: Robotics
dimensions.notes: Physical automation: labour, manufacturing, military and domestic.

dimensions.name: Cybernetics
dimensions.notes: Degree of bodily machine integration beyond therapeutic need.

dimensions.name: BCI
dimensions.notes: Brain-computer interface reach, from clinical assistance to shared or collective neural participation.

dimensions.name: Biotech
dimensions.notes: Biological engineering: medicine and repair through to redesign of the organism.

dimensions.name: Virtuality
dimensions.notes: How immersive mediated reality is, up to minds that no longer require a fixed biological substrate.

dimensions.name: Space
dimensions.notes: Permanent presence beyond the surface: none, orbital infrastructure, or interplanetary reach.

dimensions.name: Energy
dimensions.notes: Whether energy is the binding constraint on a region's capability.

dimensions.name: Manufacturing
dimensions.notes: Distribution and autonomy of production, from central plants to local fabrication to self-directed matter assembly.

dimensions.name: Psionics
dimensions.notes: Noöspheric technology. Fringe: anecdotal and contested. Reproducible: dependable under stated conditions. Industrialized: infrastructural.

dimensions.name: Noösphere
dimensions.notes: Whether the noösphere is a figure of speech, something that can be instrumented, or something built into infrastructure.

dimensions.name: Governance
dimensions.notes: Form of political authority, including formations that are not states in the modern sense.

dimensions.name: Ecology
dimensions.notes: Biosphere condition and whether it is being actively repaired.

ideological_postures.name: Accelerationist
ideological_postures.summary: Pushes the paradigm shift forward: deployment, scale, experimentation, adoption.

ideological_postures.name: AI Critical
ideological_postures.summary: Not anti-technology: deliberately restricts some trajectories while remaining advanced in others, especially medicine, ecology, public infrastructure and democratic cybernetics.

ideological_postures.name: Doomer / anti-AI
ideological_postures.summary: Suppresses autonomous systems and may diverge into hardened analog, human-controlled, biological or religious technologies rather than falling behind.

ideological_postures.name: Regional hybrid
ideological_postures.summary: Combinations that do not fit the three-way split, including regions that are simultaneously ultra-advanced and materially ruined.

$position_kinds_note: The three postures above are the ideological responses the issue names. They are NOT the ideology.json position_kinds, which are per-paradigm-shift (accelerationist / critical / doomer / hybrid). A region's tech posture is a summary of its ideological response to the AI/AGI shift specifically, and may differ from its positions on other axes.

regions.name: United States
regions.summary: Failed accelerationist superpower: maximum technological capability plus minimum social stability.
regions.posture_note: Went full Accelerationist, suffered both rogue-AGI catastrophes, and is now a fragmented failed state. The surviving corporations continue the accelerationist project better than the state does.
regions.profile_note: The profile is bimodal, not uniform: elite and corporate zones run at the upper end of each scale while the devastated interior is salvage economy. Reading it as one flat high profile is the misreading this matrix exists to prevent.
gains: peak capability in AI, cybernetics, biotech and orbital infrastructure
corporate sovereignty can mobilise resources faster than any surviving state
advanced virtuality offers exit from a ruined physical environment
vulnerabilities: no legitimate central authority to coordinate at scale
catastrophically degraded physical and ecological infrastructure in the interior
autonomous systems that outlived their owners and cannot be switched off
private security is the only reliable guarantee of order, which makes order a commodity
regions.genre_reading: Eclipse Phase-level inside elite and corporate zones, post-apocalyptic salvage elsewhere.

regions.name: European Federation
regions.summary: AI Critical welfare cybernetics: apparently conservative capability, deliberately chosen for robustness.
regions.posture_note: Deliberately slowed or regulated some AGI and automation trajectories, so it looks technologically conservative beside the surviving US megacorporate zones while remaining politically coherent, stable, relatively egalitarian and ecologically healthier.
gains: universal public BCI infrastructure and privacy-preserving digital identity
public AI, democratic cybernetics and cooperative automation
ecological engineering and biosphere restoration
infrastructure, healthcare and public transport that keep working
vulnerabilities: depends on infrastructure that a determined adversary can target
regulated AI may mean slower response to a capability it did not anticipate
political coherence is the load-bearing asset: lose it and the capability gap becomes acute
regions.genre_reading: Cyberpunk+ with selective transhumanism, and socially far more functional.
regions.open_question: Is the European Federation actually technologically behind, or has it optimised for robustness, ecological sustainability and human autonomy rather than raw capability?

regions.name: China
regions.summary: Closed post-AGI synthesis: possibly extremely advanced and deliberately opaque.
regions.posture_note: Experienced its own rogue-AGI crisis and became much more closed afterwards. Outside observers do not really understand the resulting system.
regions.profile_note: Most non-null entries are marked opaque: the profile records the author's stated synthesis, not an observed capability. Null values are dimensions the issue does not assign; a blank stays blank rather than being filled.
gains: state-scale cognitive systems and human-machine planning assemblages
collective BCIs and post-individual identity systems
technologies that do not fit Western categories of either 'AI' or 'human'
vulnerabilities: opacity is itself a vulnerability against outsiders who must guess
a system built on different assumptions about individuality is hard to interoperate with
unknown to outside observers by design, so no external actor can model its failure modes
regions.genre_reading: Unknown; possibly extremely advanced but opaque.

regions.name: Russia
regions.summary: Post-defeat civil war: uneven military cyberpunk and salvage society.
regions.posture_note: Fragmented after military defeat by federal European armies. Western regions contain EU-aligned or EU-supported factions; eastern regions Chinese-aligned or Chinese-supported; autonomous, military, nationalist, criminal, corporate and local formations hold the space between.
regions.profile_note: The governance value is nominal: no single authority holds the territory, so 'platform_state' describes competing platform-like formations rather than one state.
gains: autonomous weapons and abandoned military AI available to whoever can hold them
proxy warfare makes the region a laboratory for experimental governance
smuggling and black-market cybernetics move capability faster than regulation can
vulnerabilities: no coherent authority to maintain any infrastructure
ruined nuclear and industrial infrastructure is a standing hazard
military AI with unclear ownership and no off switch
the region is a theatre for outside powers rather than a subject of its own future
regions.genre_reading: Uneven military cyberpunk plus salvage society.

zones.name: Autonomous, military, nationalist, criminal, corporate and local formations

regions.name: Middle East
regions.summary: Butlerian Jihad: strongly anti-autonomous-AI, and not thereby backward.
regions.posture_note: A broad rejection of autonomous machine intelligence. Technological development diverges rather than stops, into human-controlled computation, hardened analog systems, biotech, religious cybernetics, non-AI expert systems, anti-machine warfare, human memory and cognition enhancement, and psionics and noöspheric practice.
gains: no exposure to the class of catastrophe that destroyed the United States
hardened analog and human-controlled systems that survive what autonomy-dependent systems do not
biotech, cognition enhancement and psionics developed on a different research programme
religious cybernetics: machine integration interpreted within an existing tradition rather than against it
vulnerabilities: cannot field autonomous systems against adversaries who can
banned AI means banned capabilities along with the risks
internal disagreement about the Jihad's scope is a live political fracture
regions.genre_reading: Highly advanced but strongly anti-autonomous-AI, with growing noöspheric technologies.

jinn.question: Do entities encountered through psionics, altered states, quantum consciousness or the noösphere correspond to older traditions concerning jinn?
jinn.$resolution_note: Deliberately unresolved. NoöPunk must not settle whether these are independent NHI, psychological entities, panpsychic structures, interdimensional beings, collective thoughtforms, or something else entirely.

regions.name: India
regions.summary: Noöspheric renaissance: a paradigm shift that arrives as continuity rather than crisis.
regions.posture_note: The paradigm shift is less culturally destructive because many of the new discoveries can be interpreted through existing philosophical and religious traditions, while many old religious and secular worldviews elsewhere enter crisis.
gains: consciousness research, panpsychism, idealism and quantum cognition as mainstream science
advanced meditation technologies and nervous-system engineering
psionics and noöspheric institutions
post-materialist science with cultural authority rather than marginal status
vulnerabilities: strength in consciousness and aerospace domains does not transfer to every domain
a renaissance is a claim about culture, not a guarantee of resilience
its advantage is illegible to rivals who measure only autonomous-AI capability
regions.genre_reading: Eclipse Phase-level in selected consciousness, aerospace and biotech domains, but culturally distinct from Western transhumanism.

playful_reinterpretations.reading: advanced aerospace or anomalous propulsion systems

ganesh.$resolution_note: Whether this means a literal divine manifestation, an AI or NHI, a collective noöspheric entity, a cultural-symbolic event, or something stranger is deliberately left open.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.summary: Unexpectedly healthy future: heterogeneous, resilient, decentralised.
regions.posture_note: Deliberately not the standard cyberpunk ruined extraction zone. In NoöPunk it may be one of the healthier macro-regions, for structural reasons rather than by exception.
regions.$profile_note: Low robotics and no orbital presence are recorded plainly rather than treated as deficits: the region's advantages are distributed resilience and local fabrication, not peak capability in every dimension.
gains: less dependence on legacy infrastructure that failed elsewhere
decentralised energy, distributed manufacturing and mesh networks
mobile-first institutions and leapfrogging of centralised industrial systems
cooperative and commons-based development with local ownership
less exposure to some AGI catastrophes
pan-African political integration and new cultural confidence
vulnerabilities: distributed systems are harder to scale into a single large programme
lower peak capability in robotics and space
climate pressure continues regardless of technological adaptation
regions.genre_reading: Heterogeneous, resilient, decentralised, and often healthier than richer regions.
structural_reasons: less exposure to some AGI catastrophes

rogue_agi_catastrophes.name: First Rogue AGI Holocaust
rogue_agi_catastrophes.significance: The first major proof that AGI catastrophe was possible. It did not change the accelerationist course; it was read as a containment success.
rogue_agi_catastrophes.$attribution_note: Company attributions are speculative NoöPunk setting fiction about a fictional future event, not claims about the real companies or any real incident.

rogue_agi_catastrophes.name: Second Rogue AGI Holocaust
rogue_agi_catastrophes.resolution: Required large-scale EMP attacks, including nuclear EMP, to shut down infrastructure controlled by the rogue system.
rogue_agi_catastrophes.significance: Much of the continental United States was devastated. The surviving United States is a fragmented failed state.
rogue_agi_catastrophes.$attribution_note: Company attributions are speculative NoöPunk setting fiction about a fictional future event, not claims about the real companies or any real incident.

megacorporate_blocs.$comment: Fictionalised future megacorporate blocs that may descend from present-day companies. Setting elements only.
megacorporate_blocs.note: The corporations that helped create the old accelerationist order survive better than the state does.

gameplay_guidance.$comment: Narrative and scenario guidance for the author's use. NOT rules: AGENTS.md §4 keeps equipment statistics, economy, vehicles and detailed simulation mechanics unresolved, and this section produces no modifiers, costs or point values.
gameplay_guidance.principle: Travelling between regions should feel like moving between different science-fiction genres.
examples: An EU character enters a US orbital corporate enclave: massive capability shock.
A US corporate transhuman enters rural Europe: surprised by the absence of omnipresent autonomous AI.
Chinese systems appear incomprehensible because they are based on different assumptions about individuality.
Indian psionic technology may outperform Western cybernetics in entirely different domains.
African distributed systems may survive catastrophes that destroy sophisticated centralised systems.
Butlerian regions may be almost impossible for autonomous AI characters to enter.
gameplay_guidance.$tone_note: These are tonal registers available inside one coherent world, not separate settings.

runtime_guidance.shared: This file is the canonical regional technology model for the runtimes. Do not re-declare a region's profile inside a runtime.
runtime_guidance.tabletop: Use for scenario seeding, travel consequences and faction design: what a character notices crossing a border.
runtime_guidance.godot: Read this data rather than hard-coding a region profile in scene scripts.
runtime_guidance.concordia: May reason over the profiles; must not invent new canonical regions or dimensions, and must not derive a numeric tech score.
runtime_guidance.not_yet: No numeric technology score, no tech-level modifier, no equipment availability table, and no economy. Those require the author.
